blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Finance (DOF) is urging Congress to fast-track the multinational minimum tax bill to prevent billions of pesos in lost revenue, while consulting neighboring economies that have already adopted the policy. The Multinational Minimum Tax (MMT) Act of 2026, filed as House Bill No. 11114 last Sept. 3 with Albay Rep. Raymond Adrian Salceda as principal author, seeks to adopt the Qualified Domestic Minimum Top-up Tax (QDMTT), a domestic top-up tax for large multinational enterprise (MNE) groups earning income in the Philippines.
